releases.body: Use the publishable npm package name @finger_xie/opencode-plugin-litellm. The unscoped opencode-plugin-litellm package is owned by another maintainer, and @yuyu1025 is not an existing npm scope for the logged-in account.
Superseded by v0.1.2. v0.1.1 used @yuyu1025/opencode-plugin-litellm, but that npm scope does not exist for the current npm account. Use @finger_xie/opencode-plugin-litellm instead.

Superseded by v0.1.1. The original v0.1.0 release used the unscoped npm package name opencode-plugin-litellm, which is already owned by another maintainer. Use @yuyu1025/opencode-plugin-litellm instead.
